chr.title: Chromosome
chr.description: Chromosome the feature lies on, prefixed with 'chr'. Scaffolds and patch regions use UCSC-style names.

start.title: Start
start.description: Start of the feature, 0-based and inclusive.

end.title: End
end.description: End of the feature, 0-based and exclusive.

strand.title: Strand
strand.description: Strand of the transcript the feature belongs to: '+' for the forward strand, '-' for the reverse strand.

type.title: Type
type.description: Kind of sub-transcript feature. Exons and their CDS, UTR, start_codon, and stop_codon sub-features are taken from the GENCODE annotation, and the sub-features share the exon_id of the exon they fall in. Introns are not annotated by GENCODE and are derived from the gaps between consecutive exons of a transcript.

transcript_id.title: Transcript ID
transcript_id.description: ENSEMBL transcript ID, without version number.

transcript_name.title: Transcript Name
transcript_name.description: GENCODE transcript name, which is the gene symbol followed by a transcript index.

exon_number.title: Exon Number
exon_number.description: 1-based index of the exon within its transcript. An intron is numbered by the two exons it separates, joined by an underscore.

exon_id.title: Exon ID
exon_id.description: Ensembl exon ID, including its version suffix.

version.title: Version
version.description: GENCODE release the annotation was taken from.

accessible_via.return: _id, name, chr, start, end, strand, type, gene_id, gene_name, transcript_id, transcript_name, exon_number, exon_id, source, version, source_url, organism
